title: Signature Math Mapping — Base64
description: How the Signature bitstring reads as Base64 (Base systems). Base64 encodes arbitrary binary data as 64 printable ASCII characters (A-Z, a-z, 0-9, +, /), 3 bytes -> 4 characters. Used anywhere binary must travel as text.

fields.name: Base64
fields.system: Base64 encodes arbitrary binary data as 64 printable ASCII characters (A-Z, a-z, 0-9, +, /), 3 bytes -> 4 characters. Used anywhere binary must travel as text.
fields.mapping: Pack the 144 Signature bits into 18 bytes, then Base64-encode them. The result is a 24-character text token that carries the entire Signature grid losslessly.
apply: 1. Take the 144-bit Signature string and pad to a multiple of 8 bits (already is: 18 bytes).
2. Convert each 3-byte group to 4 Base64 characters using the standard alphabet.
3. The 24-character token is the Base64 form. Decode reverses it exactly.
